ios.desc:
RepoFlow App lets you run a lightweight package repository server directly on your iPhone or iPad, making it easy to test, demo, or develop locally without external infrastructure.

The app supports hosting Docker, Maven, and PyPI repositories directly on your device, allowing you to push, pull, and explore packages over your local network. It is ideal for developers who want a simple, portable setup for experiments, CI testing, demos, or offline work.

You can also explore RepoFlow, a powerful package repository manager that supports Docker, npm, PyPI, Maven, NuGet, and more. Browse repositories, learn about features, and see how RepoFlow helps developers and teams manage packages with ease, all from within the app.

No account is required.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Docker registry running natively on iPhone (as part of RepoFlow)

quotes.text:
We built something unusual during a weekend hackathon: a fully working Docker registry that runs directly on iOS. No servers, no external setup, and no cloud required. Just install the app and your iPhone becomes a portable registry.

You can push, pull, and manage Docker images locally. It's part of a broader project called RepoFlow, focused on making package management simple and self-hosted.

Would love to hear your thoughts or feedback.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/repoflow/id6744822121
Project: https://www.repoflow.io
